physical_failure.scenario: A child selected a second shared game while the first game was active on a retained stream.
physical_failure.observed: The first verified stop returned 200 and the child time attachment ended, but every immediate replacement start returned 409 retained_process_unconfirmed while the host correctly remained Stream ready.
physical_failure.expected: Stop the old game, retain the existing stream, and start the new shared game without a hard reset.

root_causes: A successful provider_transition /game/stop-verified receipt completed the fenced control operation but did not retire the exact stopped provider process identity from control.stream.

When the Bridge idle process scan was unavailable, child_time_session_start correctly failed closed against that stale token. Because the successful receipt was not reconciled into the retained stream record, the barrier could persist indefinitely even though the old process had been verified stopped.
changes: Reconcile a successful provider_transition stop receipt into the retained stream and clear only its exact provider_game_id, process_token and process_id.
Require exact client, actor, execution profile, stream ID, Sunshine app ID, generation, actor lease epoch, child session, game and process-token evidence before retiring the identity.
Repair the same exact persisted pre-fix state on Gateway restart only when no control operation is active.
Keep the retained stream owner, stream ID, Sunshine app ID, generation and actor lease epoch unchanged, and never close the streamer as part of this repair.

validation.failing_before: 1 regression failed before the production correction because provider_game_id remained steam:123 after the successful verified stop.
validation.new_regressions: 3/3 PASS: immediate different-game start on the same retained stream, restart repair of an exact persisted receipt, and rejection of a receipt for a replacement process token.

validation.gateway_related: 128/128 PASS: python -m unittest test_child_time_contract test_child_time_control test_child_sessions_http test_session_recovery test_control_operations
validation.android_targeted: PASS on JDK 17: ConsoleStreamTransitionCoordinatorTest, RetainedStreamSessionCoordinatorTest, ConsoleActivityEnsureContractTest and ChildSessionClientTest

delivery.note: Gateway 0.7.116 was delivered through MoonWakerHotUpdater and its installed/runtime source hashes match the repository. Android production source did not change, so no APK was rebuilt or installed.

limitations: Unit tests establish exact state and fencing behavior but do not prove physical process replacement or stream continuity on Windows and TV.
The shared worktree remains heavily dirty; all unrelated existing changes were preserved and no commit was created.
